q: give me a net profit breakdown, waterfall for September 2026
answer:
Net profit for September 2026 was a loss of -₹172,227 on an order-date P&L (order_pnl_* lines), meaning P&L booked by event/order date; this loss comes mainly from very high P&L ad spend relative to contribution margin.

- The headline bridge: Gross sales ₹2,253,539 → net sales (P&L) ₹1,697,336 → contribution margin ₹1,021,095 → less P&L ad spend ₹1,193,322 = Net profit -₹172,227.  
- Biggest negative drivers (September): Ad spend (P&L) ₹1,193,322 (single largest outflow), Net COGS ₹676,241 (product + operating costs), and Return revenue ₹371,999 which trimmed net sales. Together these explain why a positive contribution margin (₹1,021,095) still produced a loss.  
- Positive / offsetting items: Gross sales were ₹2,253,539 and P&L net sales ₹1,697,336 — sales exist but post-discounts/returns/cancels reduced the base for profitability.

Worth checking: ad spend effectiveness (ROAS) and returns by product/category — reducing either would materially help net profit given the large ad spend and return volumes.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
